# Setup

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

genomedir <- here("species/crob/KY21")
resdir <- here(genomedir, "results/genes")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# tf genes ====================================================================
tf_ghost <- read_tsv(here(resdir, "geneset_tf_ghost-curated.tsv"))
tf_go <- read_tsv(here(resdir, "geneset_tf.tsv")) # this is the first list we made based on go annotation combined from emapper and prost, and KEGG annotation

# human transcription factor list from Lambert et al 2018 =====================
tf_hs_lambert <- read_csv("https://humantfs.ccbr.utoronto.ca/download/v_1.01/DatabaseExtract_v_1.01.csv") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  filter(is_tf == "Yes")

genes <- read_tsv(here(resdir, "gene-display-names.tsv")) %>% 
  select(-display_name)

ghost <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/ghost/gene-info_ghostdb_parsed.tsv"))
prost <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/prost/processed/best-hits_gene-level_with-gene-names.tsv"))
```

# Homologs of human transcription factors

```{r}
tf_cr_lambert_homologs <- ghost %>% 
  filter(hsap_homolog_symbol %in% tf_hs_lambert$hgnc_symbol)

tf_cr_lambert_homologs
```

# Curate the list

## Intersection of all sets

```{r}
tf_intersect <- list(select(tf_cr_lambert_homologs, gene_id),
                     select(tf_go, gene_id),
                     select(tf_ghost, gene_id)) %>% 
  reduce(inner_join, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  left_join(genes, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  distinct() 
```

## Union of all sets

```{r}
tf_union <- list(select(tf_cr_lambert_homologs, gene_id),
                 select(tf_go, gene_id),
                 select(tf_ghost, gene_id)) %>% 
  reduce(full_join, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  left_join(genes, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  distinct() 
```

# Write files

```{r}
write_tsv(tf_intersect, here(resdir, "geneset_tf_intersect.tsv"))
write_tsv(tf_union, here(resdir, "geneset_tf_union.tsv"))
```
